tools.name: daras_list_products
tools.description: List the store's products (catalog). Cursor paging: pass nextCursor back as cursor. Merchant API: GET /catalog/products.

tools.name: daras_get_product
tools.description: Get one product with its variants and images. Merchant API: GET /catalog/products/{id}.

tools.name: daras_list_categories
tools.description: List the store's product categories. Cursor paging. Merchant API: GET /catalog/categories.

tools.name: daras_list_collections
tools.description: List the store's collections (curated product groups). Cursor paging. Merchant API: GET /catalog/collections.

tools.name: daras_get_collection
tools.description: Get one collection and its products. Merchant API: GET /catalog/collections/{id}.

tools.name: daras_list_low_stock
tools.description: List variants at or below their low-stock threshold. Good first call for restocking. Cursor paging. Merchant API: GET /catalog/inventory/low-stock.

tools.name: daras_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the store's warehouses (stock locations). Cursor paging. Merchant API: GET /warehouses.

tools.name: daras_list_warehouse_stock
tools.description: List the stock levels of one warehouse, per product and variant. Cursor paging. Merchant API: GET /warehouses/{id}/stock.

tools.name: daras_list_orders
tools.description: List the store's orders for one customer. Daras requires customerId on this endpoint; get it from daras_list_customers. Cursor paging. Merchant API: GET /orders.

tools.name: daras_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with its lines, totals, payment and shipping state. Merchant API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: daras_list_order_events
tools.description: List the event history of one order (status changes, payments, notes). Cursor paging. Merchant API: GET /orders/{id}/events.

tools.name: daras_list_returns
tools.description: List return requests, optionally for one order or one status (REQUESTED, APPROVED, RECEIVED, REFUNDED, REJECTED, CANCELLED). Cursor paging. Merchant API: GET /returns.

tools.name: daras_get_return
tools.description: Get one return request with its items and status history. Merchant API: GET /returns/{id}.

tools.name: daras_list_customers
tools.description: List the store's customers. Cursor paging. Merchant API: GET /customers.

tools.name: daras_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer's profile and addresses. Merchant API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: daras_list_fulfillment_orders
tools.description: List fulfillment orders (the warehouse work per order), optionally filtered by status (OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, HOLD, FULFILLED, CANCELLED, CLOSED). Merchant API: GET /fulfillment-orders.

tools.name: daras_get_fulfillment_order
tools.description: Get one fulfillment order with its lines and status. Merchant API: GET /fulfillment-orders/{id}.

tools.name: daras_list_carriers
tools.description: List the shipping carriers available to the store. Cursor paging. Merchant API: GET /shipments/carriers.

tools.name: daras_track_shipment
tools.description: Get the tracking events of one shipment. Merchant API: GET /shipments/{id}/tracking.

tools.name: daras_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions of the store (their URLs and events). Cursor paging. Merchant API: GET /webhooks.

tools.name: daras_update_variant
tools.description: Change a variant's name, barcode, price, compare-at price or low-stock threshold. This changes the live shop price or label. Set only the fields to change. Merchant API: PATCH /catalog/variants/{id}.

tools.name: daras_set_warehouse_stock
tools.description: Set the on-hand quantity of one product (or variant) in one warehouse. It replaces the stored quantity, so repeating the call gives the same result. This changes live stock. Merchant API: POST /warehouses/stock.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: daras_list_webhooks · Public sink: daras_list_webhooks, daras_set_warehouse_stock.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: daras_list_webhooks · Public sink: daras_list_webhooks, daras_set_warehouse_stock

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
